senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בע, akin to בץ, בט)to trample, strike, kick.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:5:4">Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ</cite> top <he>בְּעָטָתוֹ פרדה</he> a mule kicked him.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:11">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>ב׳ בפילקי</he> knocked against the prison door (burst it open).
Ab. Zar. IV, 8 גת בְּעוּטָה a wine press packed with stamped grapes.—Trnsf. (with ב) to resist, reject.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:1">B. Kam. II, 1</cite>. <he>היתה מְבָעֶטֶת</he> if the animal kicked.
Ber. 32ᵃ; a. e.—Trnsf. to kick against, rebel, be contumacious.
<cite ref="Sotah 22a">Sot. 22ᵃ</cite>. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot., a. e. <he>מְבָעֵט בייסורין</he> bearing suffering with contumacy (instead of showing repentance).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 47:1">Pesik. R. s. 47</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 908:15">Yalk. Job 908</cite> <he>התחיל מב׳</he> (sub. <he>בייסורין</he>) began to be contumacious (challenging the Lord).
